intro.text: I'm Sam Hyde. I'm an important thinker.

trash.text: Trash economy. You use cubes of trash as money. Everybody becomes rich. It's a gold rush.

close_eyes.text: Close your eyes. Everybody in this room, close your eyes.

grovlers.text: Depth grovlers will live underground in tiered cities.

maglev.text: Use maglev trains to get resources to the Moon.

coffee.text: You're drinking Bulletproof Coffee and you don't even realize you're getting all jagged up in the head.

pat.text: Guys, pat yourselves on the back right now.

reset_clock.text: Can we reset the clock so I have another minute extra?

trash_rain.text: Trash economy. The abundance of trash.

hurt.4.text: Is this anybody's? I'm claiming that there, right.

hurt.5.text: You did good in school. I didn't do that good.

taunt.1.text: What inspires you? What inspires you?

taunt.3.text: Look at us. We're the machine that keeps the world going.

taunt.4.text: By my calculations, we have five years until the world ends.

taunt.5.text: Have you ever had sea cheesy baked potatoes? That'll blow your socks off.

taunt.6.text: Video games are going to get more realistic.

taunt.7.text: Fuel efficient vehicles getting eighty, a hundred miles per gallon. It's not that crazy.

taunt.8.text: I'm going to have your mind uploaded to my, my BlackBerry.

taunt.9.text: You'll be cryogenically frozen. I know it.

taunt.10.text: There's no more individual anymore. It's just the hive.
